slides.name: 02_문제
title: 자만추의 끝,
숫자가 말해주네요
slides.video_prompt: A Korean man in his late thirties with a plain, average, unremarkable appearance. He waits at a bus stop in the early evening, checking the time, mild fatigue showing on his face. Korean ethnicity, short black hair, simple grey jacket. Handheld documentary footage, flat natural lighting, ordinary everyday scene, subject in lower portion of frame.
slides._note: ⚠️ 이 프롬프트를 따라 쓰지 말 것 — 고급스러움 기준 미달 사례다. 'Korean man' 이 배우 얼굴 유사성으로 copyright 5연속 거부되자 장면 전체를 plain/average/bus stop/flat lighting 으로 내려 통과시켰다. 거부는 피했지만 브랜드가 깎였다. 올바른 순서는 SKILL.md 5-3 '고급스러움 vs 저작권' 참고: 의상·공간·조명의 고급스러움은 유지하고 얼굴만 탈스타화할 것.
slides._note_good_example: ✅ 2026-08-04 크리스찬 4번은 이 형태로 'Korean man' 이 거부 없이 1회 통과했다 — 따라 쓸 것: 'A refined Korean man in his late thirties wearing an impeccably tailored charcoal suit, standing with calm assured posture in the bright lobby of an upscale building, a composed and trustworthy expression, hands relaxed at his sides, blurred elegant architecture behind him, refined cinematic editorial photography, elegant soft natural light, shallow depth of field, ... subject in the lower portion of the frame with clean negative space at the top. Completely empty clean environment with no documents, no papers, no screens, no books, no signage and no text or writing anywhere in the frame.' 단 통과해도 배우를 닮을 수 있으니 5-5 눈검사 4번 항목으로 확인할 것.

slides.name: 03_핵심인사이트
title: 검증이 없으면

slides.video_prompt: A confident Korean woman in her thirties in professional attire, reviewing certification documents with a focused, intelligent expression. Korean ethnicity, dark hair neatly tied back. Elegant office setting with soft natural light and warm color grading. slides._note: 최초 거부 사유는 오디오였다. generate_audio=false 만으로 충분했고 프롬프트를 완화할 필요가 없었다.

slides.name: 04_디테일1
title: 신뢰는 서류로
증명합니다
slides.video_prompt: A confident Korean woman in her thirties in an elegant beige suit, standing in a modern minimalist office with a warm, competent and trustworthy expression, natural relaxed posture, subtle movement. Korean ethnicity, dark hair neatly tied back. Bright natural light through large windows, blurred city skyline behind her. Completely empty clean environment with no documents, no papers, no screens, no books, no signage and no text or writing anywhere in the frame. Editorial photography, shallow depth of field, subject in lower portion of frame.
slides._note: 서류를 등장시키지 않는다. '4대 서류 인증'을 말하는 슬라이드지만 서류를 화면에 넣으면 AI가 반드시 가짜 한글을 박는다(3회 시도 전부 실패: '직직직식직전', '딜지릭텬미의지극4색선', '집식릭 실리지'). no letters/no writing 을 강하게 써도 소용없다. 서류는 카피로만 말하고 화면엔 인물만 둔다.
